RimHex.HexEliteDef.label: Thunder armor
RimHex.HexEliteDef.description: Damage taken is divided by 1.35. Every 6 seconds in combat, marks a nearby target for lightning that strikes the marked area after 1.5 seconds.

RimHex.HexEliteDef.label: Molten
RimHex.HexEliteDef.description: Every 6 seconds in combat, marks a nearby target's position. After 2 seconds, a molten field forms there for 5 seconds. Move out of the orange area to avoid it.

RimHex.HexEliteDef.label: Echo
RimHex.HexEliteDef.description: While able to act, creates a phantom with half health for 20 seconds. Each elite can do this once. Phantoms cannot create further phantoms.

RimHex.HexEliteDef.label: Regrowth
RimHex.HexEliteDef.description: Every 5 seconds, heals its own injuries and up to two trial allies within 8 cells.

RimHex.HexEliteDef.label: Fury
RimHex.HexEliteDef.description: Deals more damage as its health falls, up to 90% additional damage.

RimHex.HexEliteDef.label: Command
RimHex.HexEliteDef.description: Other trial allies within 10 cells deal 35% more damage and take 15% less damage. Multiple command auras do not stack.

RimHex.HexTrialDef.label: Thunder dome
RimHex.HexTrialDef.description: Every 8 seconds, the Storm King marks up to three targets. Lightning strikes the marked positions after 2 seconds. Move out of the blue warning areas. Stunning the boss can interrupt pending strikes.

RimHex.HexTrialDef.label: Furnace depths
RimHex.HexTrialDef.description: Every 8 seconds, the Furnace colossus charges a heavy strike. After 2.5 seconds it hits the target area, leaving molten ground for 5 seconds. Avoid the orange warning and the burning ground it leaves behind.

RimHex.HexTrialDef.label: Hall of souls
RimHex.HexTrialDef.description: Every 8 seconds in combat, the Soul Sovereign summons two short-lived servants and heals its injuries. Each nearby ally grants it 10% damage, up to 60%. Killing the servants weakens the boss.

HediffDef.label: Trial phantom
HediffDef.description: An enemy formed by the trial beacon. Its abilities, difficulty and boss attacks are saved with the current trial.

ThingDef.label: Prismatic trial beacon
ThingDef.description: Start a three-wave prismatic trial at home. Build outdoors with reachable open ground 18–30 cells around it. After each wave, claim rewards and leave or continue. Enemies will attack the colony, and injuries persist. The beacon is immune to damage and can still be uninstalled or deconstructed.
